versions.changelog:
- Major update: skill completely overhauled and refocused on cognitive-based daily reflection.
- Transitioned from an automated, cron-driven analysis workflow to an interactive, user-guided journaling process based on "Cognitive Awakening".
- Removed prior technical steps (day analysis, solution memory updates, morning briefing, etc.); now emphasizes fact-feeling-insight-action reflection for 1-3 significant events per day.
- Added reference guides: prompts library and cognitive awakening framework.
- Output format changed to concise reflection notes with "事件" (events), insights, and actionable changes.
- Old files (README.md, assets, and package.json) removed in favor of reference-based guidance.
